stem:
Ritu's list of marks has mean $40$. She inserts the three new marks $30$, $40$, and $50$ together.

What happens to the mean?

options.text: Report the inserted group $30$, $40$, $50$ as the new mean, ignoring the old list.
Decide the mean is unchanged without checking those three marks against the existing mean $40$.
The mean stays $40$, because $30$, $40$, and $50$ average to $40$ and balance about the existing mean.
Say that keeping the mean fixed is what creates the three inserted marks.

teacher.key_rationale: A group leaves the mean unchanged when its own average equals the existing mean. Here $(30+40+50)/3=40$. Replacing the mean by the group, skipping the balance check, or reversing mean and inserts all miss that test.
